channel.title: Blockchain Today
channel.description: Blockchain Today reports crypto news on Bitcoin, Ethereum, DeFi, stablecoins, exchanges, regulation and network upgrades, with analysis of what changed.

item.title: A holder count needs a dust line
item.description: A holder count treats every nonzero wallet alike; a dust-adjusted count sets a balance cutoff, making token growth easier to compare while exposing the threshold.

item.title: Getting Stablecoins onto Polygon Before Checkout
item.description: The route depends on where your stablecoin sits: use a supported Polygon withdrawal when available, or bridge it, then verify the checkout network, token and fee balance.

item.title: Poocoin Charts Show BNB Token Prices; Wallet Views Add Context
item.description: Poocoin pairs BNB Smart Chain token charts with wallet views, but a pool price and an address history answer different questions and need separate checks.

item.title: SEC proposes guarded crypto self-custody for advisers and funds
item.description: The SEC proposed new custody options for advisers and funds, including conditional self-custody and state trust companies, while retaining safeguards for crypto assets.

item.title: SEC proposal opens conditional crypto self-custody for advisers
item.description: The SEC’s proposed rules would let advisers and regulated funds self-custody some crypto when no permitted custodian is available, subject to added safeguards.

item.title: Omnichain Routes: Compare Settlement, Cost and Trust
item.description: Omnichain transfers simplify moving tokens between networks, but route choice still turns on what arrives, how it settles, what it costs and which system verifies it.

item.title: Base Cobalt adds conditional transactions and issuer controls
item.description: Base’s Cobalt upgrade went live on Sept. 30, adding state-gated transactions and issuer controls to B20 as tokenized assets gain new tools across its Ethereum layer 2.
